title: Hearth of Stone
shortDescription: Granite takes the weight and does not complain.
longDescription:
The Hearth of Stone is a vaulted room that feels older than the hall that leads to it. Granite blocks fit as if they had chosen one another. Dust hangs in cool light. A carved keystone watches the door. The air smells of wet rock after rain and the faint chalk of a mason's mark.
Mentor Quern stands like another block that learned to speak.
A straw hearth dummy stands where a lesson can be finished without guessing.

fixtures.name: Mentor Quern
fixtures.lookDescription: A massive grey badger with granite-dusted paws and a mason's belt. Try talk quern.
fixtures.examineDescription: Quern's stripe is pale with stone-dust. The belt is heavy. He does not hurry a sentence, and he does not drop one.
fixtures.dialogue: "Look around this hearth. Weight first. Speech second. Defeat the hearth dummy in this room. Come back and talk to me. I will open this School's leaf and ink its stem in your Field Primer."

welcome.text: "Wet rock after rain. Mason's chalk. The keystone watching the door. Look around this hearth. Weight first. Speech second. Then attack the hearth dummy in this room — not Flint's orchard dummy, unless you are still learning the spark. Come back and talk to me. I will open this School's leaf and ink its stem."

craft.text: "The Field Primer is your book. I open this School's leaf and ink the stem after you look around this hearth, defeat the dummy, and talk to me. Later the Primer holds ink. Open the book and type ink and the vein's name. Carry the weight you named."

go.text: "Look around this hearth. Defeat the dummy. I will be here. I do not hurry a sentence, and I will not drop this one."

lessons-done.text: "The stem is inked. Cast keystone at the hearth dummy for the second lesson. After that, the Primer holds one ink. Open the book and type ink and the vein's name."

third-lesson.text: "Talk to Headmaster Alder in the High Study. Type up from the Great Hall. If he is still sending you down the Clock Tower stair, finish that first. When he says the grounds will teach the rest, come back and talk to me."

third-done.text: "College lessons in this hearth are complete. Keep the Primer. Each new lesson grants one ink. I still sign the page even when I am not at your shoulder. Holm kept a stair so first-years would not walk it dark. Eat something warm before you take a cold road."

fixtures.name: Carved Keystone
fixtures.examineDescription: The keystone is plain except for a shallow mark like a held breath. The blocks around it have not shifted. A slate says: 'Carry the weight you named.'
